messages.text:
The speaker’s refund proposal is BRL 149.65. It can only be paid to the order’s original payment method; I can’t redirect it to your sister’s account. [refund-policy/v2/payment]

If you want to continue with the refund to the original credit card, confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card. A message in chat won’t confirm it. [refund-policy/v2/approval]
